newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK salutes dead Chinese democracy activists.
newsitem.headline: HK salutes dead Chinese democracy activists.

text.p: Dozens of Hong Kong people paid tribute to Chinese democracy activists over the weekend at a traditional Chinese festival to remember the dead.
They offered flowers in memory of the Chinese protesters killed when China's government crushed the 1989 democracy movement centred on Beijing's Tiananmen Square.
The Hong Kong mourners laid the flowers before a replica of the white Goddess of Democracy statue built by the Chinese students in the movement.
The remembrance campaign started on Saturday on the annual Qingming Festival, when Chinese traditionally pay respects to dead relatives and friends.
Many people in Hong Kong, which reverts to Chinese rule on July 1 after more than 150 years as a British colony, worry about political freedom in the territory after the handover.
